description: A tall insulated water bottle whose detector box is a tight vertical sliver. The refined box covers the whole bottle, so the Item's photo shows it from cap to base. The negative twin of the lamp-base case: a box that was too tight, not shifted

photos.describe: Lavender 40 oz insulated water bottle with a black flex cap standing at the back corner of a nightstand. Detector box covers only the middle third of the bottle's width and none of the cap.

expect.crop_shows: the whole bottle including the cap and the base
